FIELDS.NAME: Precision Bindery & Printing Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Precision Bindery & Printing Solutions, we specialize in high-quality printing and binding services tailored primarily for commercial clients, including educational institutions and corporations. Our operations focus on a meticulous quality control process throughout all stages of production, ensuring that every project meets stringent standards. We utilize modern, well-maintained machinery and employ low-VOC inks to minimize environmental impact while enhancing safety in our facility. Our dedicated team is committed to maintaining compliance with OSHA standards and local fire safety regulations, including regular audits of our processes and equipment. This focus enables us to concentrate solely on providing excellent printing and binding solutions while mitigating operational risks effectively.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on 02/15/2022, due to equipment malfunction during the binding process, resulting in material damage valued at $2,500. Status: Closed. Another loss on 08/30/2022 involved a minor fire caused by an electrical short in the printer, leading to repairs costing $2,500. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-rated safe, classified as UL Class 350, for document and secure material storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security watchpersons are utilized to ensure a safe operating environment and minimize the risk of unauthorized access to the premises.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – We have not had any policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Our insurance coverage has been consistent with no interruptions.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – We do not lease employees to or from other employers; all our staff are employed directly by our organization. This allows us to maintain consistent quality and control over our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We carry Workers' Compensation coverage to ensure employee safety and compliance with legal requirements. This policy is active and provides essential protection for our workforce.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – We own and operate another business called Precision Binding & Packaging Services, which focuses on complementary binding and packaging solutions for our commercial clients.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – We currently do not have any additional insurance policies with this company beyond the ones mentioned. Our focus remains on maintaining comprehensive coverage for our printing and binding operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on providing high-quality printing and binding services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – We do not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on providing high-quality printing and binding services for our commercial clients.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Their financial standing appears stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – We do not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals as we focus exclusively on high-quality printing and binding services using low-VOC inks. Our operations prioritize safety and compliance with relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – We do not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused on high-quality printing and binding services without engaging in high-risk activities. Additionally, we maintain strong risk management and fire hazard mitigation strategies to ensure safety.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring at our organization. We maintain a strict adherence to compliance and risk management policies.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are currently no uncorrected fire code violations at Precision Bindery & Printing Solutions. We ensure compliance with all fire safety regulations and conduct regular audits to maintain a safe operating environment.
